issues.title: Implement versioned participant-field snapshots and persistence
issues.body:
## Context

Parent #224; accepted #185 research identifies the deliberate field-preparation gap after merged #219. Implement the approved openspec/changes/issue-224-participant-fields/ requirements PF-001–006 and core tasks 1.1–1.4 only after G4 authorization.

## Scope and acceptance criteria

- Record the approved ADR for ownership in setup.configuration, tournament-local identity, source/field revisions, latest-content/minimal-audit retention and independent snapshot transactions before coding.
- Prepare/replace one bracket field from explicit ACCEPTED entries; support empty and one-unit fields, retain single/pair members, original entry and current selection provenance, canonical entry-ID ordering, and no global roster-ID fabrication.
- Require creator authority plus expected field/draft/book versions. Virtual-zero reads and rejected first writes create no storage. Preserve full prior/winning state and audit on invalid/stale/concurrent operations.
- Expose conservative CURRENT/OUTDATED state from source-version equality without automatic source/field synchronization; preserve saved content after source withdrawal or bracket removal. Document that sources are current at the transaction snapshot and may change before commit.
- Add the next append-only migration (currently V8), field ownership/uniqueness constraints and atomic latest-content/audit/version writes; no existing migration, source table behavior or roster contract changes.

## Validation

Run ./service/tournamentmgmt/mvnw -B -f service/tournamentmgmt/pom.xml '-Dtest=*ParticipantField*Test' test with nonzero test counts. Use a fresh explicitly opted-in PostgreSQL database for V7 upgrade, first-write/replacement races, full winner comparisons, independent fields and forced source commits between observation and completion. Record actual synchronization/interleavings, complete rollback evidence and no source/legacy side effects. Apply full backend verification in the dependent delivery package.

## Exclusions

No draw generator, global identity, automatic capacity admission, public output, frontend or source synchronization. Existing entry/draft/announcement/JWT/CLI behavior remains compatible.

issues.title: Expose creator-only participant-field management and validate workflow
issues.body:
## Context

Parent #224; depends on the participant-field-core draft. Implement PF-001–007 and tasks 2.1–2.5 from openspec/changes/issue-224-participant-fields/ after the core and required approvals.

## Scope and acceptance criteria

- Add authenticated creator-only GET/PUT management with existing principal/JWT validation, field If-Match, explicit source versions and query/body bracket selectors. Return private snapshots/provenance, observed sources, freshness, minimal audit and manual-capacity review.
- Cover UNPREPARED/version0 without writes, saved reads after bracket removal, current-source explicit reconciliation, empty clearing, closed intake and manual capacity. No private data in the broadly readable legacy Tournament DTO.
- Distinguish documented 400/401/403/404/409 outcomes, sanitize errors and request no caching. Regression-check existing config, entry and announcement behavior.
- Document unverified local keys, original/current labels, snapshot-time/coarse freshness, latest-only contents and no draw/automatic synchronization.
- Obtain independent G5/G6, architecture/correctness/tests G7 lenses, real local Keycloak/PostgreSQL UAT, explicit human acceptance and separate merge approval. Stop task-owned test processes/containers afterward.

## Validation

Run focused ParticipantField tests plus existing entry/configuration/announcement security tests; then install IAM if needed and run ./service/tournamentmgmt/mvnw -B -f service/tournamentmgmt/pom.xml clean verify. Run npm run format:check and npx -y @fission-ai/openspec@1.14.2 validate issue-224-participant-fields --strict. Record counts, actual PostgreSQL coverage and skips. UAT includes foreign/stale access, source-change OUTDATED reads, explicit replacement, clearing and retained removed-bracket snapshots.

## Exclusions

No generator/seeding/results, verified registry, waitlist, public participant list, frontend, federation integration or changes to existing REST/JWT/CLI contracts.
